verdict.rationale: Square has extensive docs covering card payments, sandbox testing, SDKs (e.g., Node.js code sample showing payments.create), webhooks, idempotency, etc., suggesting a developer could piece together a working payment flow. However, there's no direct evidence of a single quickstart guide with copy-paste examples across multiple languages, nor confirmation of the under-a-day integration time. Missing for 10: multi-language copy-paste quickstart evidence, independent developer reports confirming fast integration time, single unified getting-started tutorial.
